scoring_justification: Only the final barriers are reported; no raw BVSE maps to recompute from, so compare the agent’s values against paper-reported barriers with tolerance and ordering check.

hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper reported activation energy of 0.25 eV for optimal Si composition from BVSE calculations
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Quoted directly from the paper's reported value for this composition and method.

outputs.description: BVSE migration barriers for two argyrodite compositions. The checker verifies that the Si-substituted barrier is lower than the parent barrier and meets a prescribed low value with tolerance.

steps.description: Validate CSV and score barrier values: Si‑substituted absolute barrier (0.7 weight) and parent‑vs‑Si ordering (0.3 weight).
